BiblicalUsage: The word ṭᵉrad carries the sense of to expel, to drive out. In Daniel 4:25, That they shall drive thee from men, and it appears again in Daniel 4:32.
TheologicalSignificance: A king driven out to live with the beasts humbles me, because pride can unmake any of us the same way.
